name: Speed Sweep Constraint
situation: 2nd & 5, own 38, vs quarters look with aggressive force

summary.motive: Force both perimeter defenders to defend the sideline honestly so they cannot cheat toward the choice shots this family lives on.
summary.whyItWorks: Jet speed forces the nickel to commit as force pre-exchange, the tight end kicks him out at the perfect landmark, and the stalk removes the corner — leaving only a safety making a hopeless alley tackle.
summary.failureMode: The nickel plays off the kickout with leverage instead of taking it head-on, spilling the carrier inside where the scraping linebacker waits.

beats.title: 1. The Jet Stretches the Edge
beats.text: The slot jets across at full speed while the line reaches right and the back fakes weak. The nickel must declare himself as force before the exchange even lands.

beats.title: 2. The Kickout Erases the Force
beats.text: The tight end kicks the nickel head-on exactly where he must be. With force eliminated, the safety inherits an alley fill he cannot make in time.

beats.title: 3. The Corner Is Stalked
beats.text: The flanker stalks the sweep-side corner as the carrier presses the numbers. Both primary force defenders are now accounted for without throwing a pass.

beats.title: 4. The Perimeter Pays
beats.text: The carrier bends up off the kickout with the whole defense flowing laterally behind him. This is the constraint that makes every choice shot credible.

relations.tell: The ball changes hands to a full-speed receiver crossing the formation — no other call in this family puts the ball on the perimeter before the second level moves.
